svg.title: Agent File on the iPhone
svg.desc: Real screens from Agent File on an iPhone, cycling one by one: HQ dashboard: Rank, XP, streak and today's case at a glance; Daily Intel: A new investigation written by Claude every day; Missions: Ciphers, crime scenes, wiretaps and witness statements; Case file: Accuracy, mistakes and XP for every closed case; Training Center: The FBI selection process, phase by phase; Career Prep: Agency profiles, exam prep and a live job board; Agent dossier: Behavioral profile, commendations and medals.
